channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Outside investment led this period: Toyota is committing more than $55M to its Toa Baja distribution center, Polaris of Canada is moving ahead with its roughly $60M Punta Lima battery project, and PharmaEssentia of Taiwan plans a $46M manufacturing plant. Global Ports Holding outlined more than $300M for San Juan's cruise port, Marriott completed a $38M Isla Verde renovation, and about $82M in new FEMA awards landed. The main risks are energy-related: record electricity rates, a possible further increase after LUMA's $48M fuel-cost notice, an estimated $32M diesel cost from New Fortress LNG delivery delays, the Oversight Board's backing of LUMA's contract amid the government's dispute with LUMA, and a stalled PREPA debt restructuring. Merchants and private-sector groups are warning about the effect of those costs on small businesses and jobs.
